prompt:
Composition lock: leave 12 percent clear background around every essential subject/prop. Full bodies, when shown, fit entirely inside the central 76 percent of the frame, including hair and shoe soles. Do not add humans or props beyond exact page. No humans anywhere. Sun, Earth and Moon have round physical outlines, never elliptical disks. The same lunar dark mare pattern persists. Diagram objects have distinct correct relative sizes, not to scale. All rays originate Sun, no ray passes through solid Earth. On page2 Earth lies clearly BELOW the unobstructed Sun-to-Moon rays, with light reflected from Moon back toward Earth; do not show eclipse alignment yet. On page9 top and bottom rows are separate comparison panels only, with no labels and no shadow cone in ordinary lunar-phase row. 
Use case: illustration-story. One finished landscape 3:2 full-bleed picture-book illustration, one coherent scene and moment, no panels or contact sheet. Bold clean clear 2D children's cartoon throughout, crisp continuous dark outlines, flat clean colors, restrained smooth cel shading, no painted or grainy texture, no gouache, no embossed relief, no 3D. Original friendly readable illustration. Ordinary neutral settings; no flags, religious/political symbols or costumes. No logos, text, letters, numbers, pseudo-writing, captions, watermarks or page borders. Natural anatomy and coherent hand/prop contact. Essential content at least 8 percent inside every edge.
 No named child cast: Kit and Zoe MUST NOT appear. Include unnamed human workers/adults ONLY when explicitly required by this particular scene; otherwise show only the natural subjects. Preserve exact reference identity and clothing.
Book: A Shadow on the Moon; World Discovery; nonfiction.
Setting: A hypothetical total lunar eclipse seen from Earth on one clear night. No dated event or claim of current visibility. Explanatory space diagrams are deliberately not to scale; daylight comes only from the Sun.
Design locks for the book's recurring subjects/props (NOT a visibility list; never insert later objects/states prematurely): Moon with consistent dark mare pattern and fully round physical outline; Diagram Sun left, Earth middle, Moon right; Earth's dark shadow extending away from Sun; thin pale atmosphere ring only when explaining filtered light
 Input references lock identity, prop design and location; compose a NEW image for the exact scene, never reproduce the reference-board layout. The reference and overall prop list may contain finished objects and later story events: these are DESIGN REFERENCES ONLY, not permission to show them now. Show only the people, objects and development stage required below.
Page 5. Printed prose (NOT text to put in art): Soon the whole Moon is inside the darkest part. It may look rusty red instead of disappearing.
Required illustration: Earthbound Moon entirely within total eclipse, dim copper-red with recognizable surface markings.
Exact current state: Moon disk not black hole or red light source; example red appearance qualified in text.
Do not add later events, duplicate props or a separate inset. No written title; the app renders live text.

visualReview.note: Total eclipse appears dim copper red with recognizable mare pattern and intact outline over same kind of rooftop; no self-luminous halo.
visualReview.limits: Direct agent image/sequence inspection; not physical classroom observation.
